mapper.select: SELECT R.REPLY_ID AS "replyId", R.CHAPTER_ID AS "chapterId", R.MEMBER_ID AS "memberId", R.CONTENT AS "content", R.FILE_ID AS "fileId", TO_CHAR(R.CREATED_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "createdDate", M.NAME AS "name", D.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS "deptName", P.POSITION_NAME AS "positionName", F.ORIGINAL_NAME AS "originalName" -- 🌟 파일 테이블의 원본 이름 FROM REPLY R JOIN MEMBER M ON (R.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID) LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON (M.DEPARTMENT_ID = D.DEPARTMENT_ID) LEFT JOIN POSITION P ON (M.POSITION_ID = P.POSITION_ID) LEFT JOIN ATTACHMENT F ON (R.FILE_ID = F.FILE_ID) -- 🌟 조인 WHERE R.CHAPTER_ID = #{chapterId} AND R.STATUS = 'Y' START WITH R.PARENT_REPLY_ID IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR R.REPLY_ID = R.PARENT_REPLY_ID ORDER SIBLINGS BY R.REPLY_ID ASC
